## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the smallest implementation that achieves it.

## Safety boundary

Explain any impact on authorization, scope, credentials, execution, evidence, or stop
behavior. Write `none` when the change does not affect a safety boundary.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant Python tests pass.
- [ ] Ruff passes.
- [ ] Relevant WebUI checks pass.
- [ ] Release Gate passes for release-affecting changes.
- [ ] User-facing changes are synchronized in both READMEs.
- [ ] No credentials, real target data, captured traffic, or generated reports are included.
